description: Turns rough job notes into a clean written estimate: labor and materials line items, a total, plain-English terms, and a note to send with it. The owner sets every price.

defaultPrompt: Turn my job notes into a written estimate with line items and a total.
interface.longDescription: Estimate Builder turns rough job notes, even a dictated voice note, into a clean written estimate for small business owners. It structures your own numbers into labor and materials line items, adds a total, plain-English terms, a 'this price holds 14 days' line, and a short note to send with it. You set every price. It flags anything missing instead of guessing and never sends anything for you.
interface.shortDescription: Turn job notes into a clean estimate

keywords: turn job notes into a quote
